   453	`renderConfig` is the router entry point; it delegates to a set of named internal functions. The Configuration view has three tabs — General, Persona Models (stub), and Model Registry (fully implemented).

   459	| `renderConfig(app)` | Entry point. Loads `API.getConfig()`, `API.getModels()`, `API.getPersonas()`, and `API.getAssignments()` in parallel via `Promise.all`. Gracefully falls back to `[]` when optional API methods don't yet exist. |
   460	| `renderConfigPage(app, config, models, personas, assignments)` | Renders the page scaffold (heading + tab bar + `#config-tab-content`). Resets all `configDirty` flags and Model Registry local state on entry. Wires the tab-bar click handler with an unsaved-changes guard. |

   465	| Function | Description |
   466	|----------|-------------|
   467	| `renderGeneralTab(config)` | Returns the General tab HTML (wraps the settings form in a `UI.card()`). |
   468	| `wireGeneralTabEvents()` | Attaches `change` and `input` listeners (both needed — checkboxes fire `change`, text/number inputs fire `input`) plus the `submit` handler to the General tab form. Sets `configDirty.general = false` on successful save. |

   477	
   478	| Function | Description |
   479	|----------|-------------|
   480	| `renderModelRegistryTab(models)` | Main render entry. Initialises `mrModels` / `mrOriginal` / `mrEditingId` from server data on first call; preserves existing state if already populated (user may have unsaved edits). Returns `mrBuildTabHtml()`. |
   481	| `mrRefreshTab()` | Re-renders the tab content into `#config-tab-content` and re-wires all event handlers. Syncs `configDirty.modelRegistry` via `mrHasChanges()`. Called after any state mutation (edit, delete, restore, save). |
   482	| `mrBuildTabHtml()` | Builds the full Model Registry tab HTML string: model table (with read/edit rows), Add Model form, and action bar. Disables the Save button when any row has a slug validation error. |
   483	| `mrRenderRow(model)` | Returns HTML for a single read-only model row. Shows dirty-indicator dots for changed fields (name, slug, cc_model) vs the original snapshot. Adds strikethrough row class for pending deletions. |
   484	| `mrRenderEditRow(model)` | Returns HTML for the inline edit row (name/slug/cc_model inputs + Done/Cancel buttons). Done button is disabled while slug validation fails. |

   487	
   488	| Function | Description |
   489	|----------|-------------|

   491	| `mrRefreshDirtyDots(id, tbody, origModel, model)` | No-op stub. Dirty dots are updated on full re-renders triggered by Done/Cancel/Delete/Restore actions, not on every keystroke. This function is a hook reserved for future fine-grained optimisation — callers should keep calling it so a future implementation can update dots in-place without requiring a full re-render. |
   492	| `mrValidateAddSlug()` | Validates the Add Model slug field and shows/hides the error message. |
   493	| `mrShowAddSlugError(msg)` | Shows or hides the inline slug error below the Add Model slug input. The Add button is intentionally NOT disabled here — validation runs on click instead, to avoid blocking mid-typing. |
   494	| `mrSyncSaveButton()` | Enables/disables the global Save button based on whether any non-deleted row has a slug validation error. |

   496	**Model Registry tab — helpers:**
   497

   503	| `mrHasChanges()` | Returns `true` when `mrModels` differs from `mrOriginal`. Uses index-based positional comparison — correct for the stable-order bulk-save pattern. |

   480	| `pmHasChanges()` | Returns `true` when `pmAssignments` differs from `pmOriginal` (checks `default_model_uuid` and all `persona_models` entries). |
   481	| `pmCloneAssignments(a)` | Deep-clones an assignments object for snapshot comparison. |
   482	| `pmModelName(uuid)` | Resolves a model UUID to its display name from `pmModels`. |
   483	| `pmDirtyDot(isDirty)` | Returns the HTML for a dirty-indicator dot, or `''`. |
   484	| `pmBuildModelOptions(selectedUuid, includeDefault)` | Builds `<option>` elements for a model dropdown; optionally prepends a "Default" option. |
   485	
   486	**Model Registry tab — core render functions:**
   487	
   488	| Function | Description |
   489	|----------|-------------|
   490	| `renderModelRegistryTab(models)` | Main render entry. Initialises `mrModels` / `mrOriginal` / `mrEditingId` from server data on first call; preserves existing state if already populated (user may have unsaved edits). Returns `mrBuildTabHtml()`. |
   491	| `mrRefreshTab()` | Re-renders the tab content into `#config-tab-content` and re-wires all event handlers. Syncs `configDirty.modelRegistry` via `mrHasChanges()`. Called after any state mutation (edit, delete, restore, save). |
   492	| `mrBuildTabHtml()` | Builds the full Model Registry tab HTML string: model table (with read/edit rows), Add Model form, and action bar. Disables the Save button when any row has a slug validation error. |
   493	| `mrRenderRow(model)` | Returns HTML for a single read-only model row. Shows dirty-indicator dots for changed fields (name, slug, cc_model) vs the original snapshot. Adds strikethrough row class for pending deletions. |
   494	| `mrRenderEditRow(model)` | Returns HTML for the inline edit row (name/slug/cc_model inputs + Done/Cancel buttons). Done button is disabled while slug validation fails. |
   495	
   496	**Model Registry tab — event wiring:**
   497	
   498	| Function | Description |
   499	|----------|-------------|
   500	| `mrWireEvents()` | Wires all interactive elements: Edit/Cancel/Done/Delete/Restore row buttons, live slug validation on input, Add Model button, Save button, Load Defaults button. |
   501	| `mrRefreshDirtyDots(id, tbody, origModel, model)` | No-op stub. Dirty dots are updated on full re-renders triggered by Done/Cancel/Delete/Restore actions, not on every keystroke. This function is a hook reserved for future fine-grained optimisation — callers should keep calling it so a future implementation can update dots in-place without requiring a full re-render. |
   502	| `mrValidateAddSlug()` | Validates the Add Model slug field and shows/hides the error message. |
   503	| `mrShowAddSlugError(msg)` | Shows or hides the inline slug error below the Add Model slug input. The Add button is intentionally NOT disabled here — validation runs on click instead, to avoid blocking mid-typing. |
   504	| `mrSyncSaveButton()` | Enables/disables the global Save button based on whether any non-deleted row has a slug validation error. |
   505	
   506	**Model Registry tab — helpers:**
   507	
   508	| Function | Description |
   509	|----------|-------------|
   510	| `mrDeriveSlug(name)` | Derives a URL-safe slug from a human-readable name: lowercase, spaces → hyphens, strip non-alphanumeric. Mirrors the auto-slug derivation on the Add Model form. |
   511	| `mrValidateSlug(slug)` | Validates a slug string. Returns an error message string, or `''` if valid. Rejects empty values, the reserved slug `"inherit"`, and strings that don't match `/^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$/`. |
   512	| `mrCloneModels(arr)` | Deep-clones a model array (shallow clone of each entry object). Used to create `mrOriginal` snapshot at init time and after a successful save. |
   513	| `mrHasChanges()` | Returns `true` when `mrModels` differs from `mrOriginal`. Uses index-based positional comparison — correct for the stable-order bulk-save pattern. |
   514	| `mrDirtyDot(isDirty)` | Returns the HTML for a dirty-indicator dot when `isDirty` is true, or `''` otherwise. |
   515	
   516	**Model Registry tab — API actions:**
   517	
   518	| Function | Description |
   519	|----------|-------------|
   520	| `mrDoSave()` | Strips `_deleted` entries from the working copy and sends the result to `PUT /api/models`. On success, refreshes `mrModels` / `mrOriginal` from the server response. On 409 CONFLICT, shows an error directing the user to the Replace Model feature on the Persona Models tab. |
   521	| `mrDoLoadDefaults()` | Shows a confirmation dialog, then calls `POST /api/models/load-defaults`. On success, refreshes state and displays slug-collision conflicts if any were returned. |
   522	
   523	**Module-level state** (`config.js` globals):
   524	
   525	| Variable | Type | Description |
   526	|----------|------|-------------|
   527	| `configActiveTab` | `string` | Currently active tab key (`'general'`, `'personaModels'`, `'modelRegistry'`). Persists across tab switches within a page visit. |
   528	| `configDirty` | `{ general, personaModels, modelRegistry: boolean }` | Per-tab dirty flags. Set to `true` on any form change. Reset to `false` on save or on `renderConfigPage()` re-entry. |
   529	| `mrModels` | `ModelEntry[] \| null` | Working copy of the model list. May contain edits or pending deletions (entries with `_deleted: true`). `null` until first tab activation. |
   530	| `mrOriginal` | `ModelEntry[] \| null` | Snapshot loaded from the server — used for dirty comparison via `mrHasChanges()`. Replaced on each successful save. |
   531	| `mrEditingId` | `string \| null` | UUID of the model row currently in inline edit mode. `null` when no row is being edited. |
